correctness.rationale: Verified precise linear order P_n=T_(n-1)...T_1, n>=2, and all-pair Gini seminorm modulo constants. Every real signal has a positive layer-cake binary-cut decomposition, so cut tests suffice. Each local averaging loses at least |a-b| in Gini; for a binary vector the carry recursion has at least geometric dissipation 1+1/2+...+2^{-(k-1)} after choosing the minority side, while a suffix block of k trailing 1s makes every triangle inequality an equality. This proves gamma_n exactly, not via finite sampling. Direct algebra comparing adjacent k choices gives small cases and strict minimum at floor(n/2) for n>=9, asymptotic n²(1-gamma)->8. Independently exhausted all nontrivial binary initial vectors at n=2..11, including gamma_5=3/4, gamma_8=53/60, gamma_9=29/32; all matched.
